# Test Memo — Clean Citations

This memo cites every substantive claim with proper authority. The auditor
should produce zero errors against this file.

## Section 1 — California

CCPA applies under Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.140(d) to a for-profit entity that does business in California and meets one of three thresholds: annual gross revenue exceeding $25 million, processing personal information of 100,000+ California consumers/households, or deriving 50% or more of annual revenue from selling/sharing personal information.

A controller must honor opt-out preference signals such as Global Privacy Control under 11 CCR § 7025.

## Section 2 — Texas

The Texas Data Privacy and Security Act applies at thresholds set forth in Tex. Bus. & Com. Code § 541.002.

TDPSA requires that controllers selling sensitive personal data include a specified disclosure under Tex. Bus. & Com. Code § 541.054(a).

## Section 3 — Colorado

Colorado Privacy Act profiling rights are governed by Colo. Rev. Stat. § 6-1-1306 and 4 CCR § 904-3.
